title: Women's Premier League batting summaries by season — wpl_batters
text: Season-level batting statistics every Women's Premier League (WPL) batter faced least 20 balls season. row one batter, playing one team, one season. Values derived Cricsheet ball--ball records; see data-raw/wpl_batters.R full preparation steps.

title: Women's Premier League batting summaries by season — wpl_batters
Women's Premier League batting summaries by season — wpl_batters
text: tibble 185 rows 14 columns: season Season label used Cricsheet, e.g. "2022/23". WPL season played early second calendar year ("2022/23" season played 2023). batting_team Franchise batter played . batter Batter's name recorded Cricsheet (initials surname). innings Number matches batter faced least one ball. runs Total runs scored bat. balls_faced Legal balls faced. Wides excluded; -balls included. dismissals Number times batter dismissed. fours Number fours hit. sixes Number sixes hit. dot_balls Balls faced batter scored runs. strike_rate Runs per 100 balls faced. dot_percent Percentage balls faced dot balls. boundary_percent Percentage balls faced hit four six. average Runs per dismissal. NA batter never dismissed.
